description: NaGa(SeO₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.83 Å. Ga is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.72 Å) and two longer (1.73 Å) Se-O bond lengths. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. All Se-O bond lengths are 1.74 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ga and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ga, and one Se atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂GaSe tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ga, and one Se atom.
